notes.scope: All product cards from the Ditch Witch brand listing (/ditch-witch/, 201 items) plus 28 JT9-relevant category listings. Entries with a "jt9" key are the JT9 pilot: "model" = Radius names JT922 / JT920-922 / JT10 (JT9 runs the same 1.30 DW pipe as JT922 coarse); "thread" = a connection matches a JT9 roadmap connection (2" IF, 2-3/8 Reg, 1.63 EZ2, DW 5/3-bolt 12mm). conn labels are verbatim Radius wording; only pilot entries have conn filled in. specs = Radius product-page custom fields where the page was fetched.
notes.machines: Only machines Radius itself names (title, image alt text, or product-page Model Compatibility). Radius never names JT9 anywhere on the site.
notes.imgPattern: https://cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-uwymjpsd0i/images/stencil/{size}/products/{bcProductId}/{imageId}/{file}__{hash}.{uploadEpoch}.jpg?c=1 ; size = 80w|160w|320w|640w|960w|1280w|1920w|2560w|500x659|1280x1280|original. Not derivable from the part number; must be scraped. Served by Cloudflare with access-control-allow-origin: * and Cache-Control max-age=31556926 public; content-negotiates webp.
notes.bcProductId: BigCommerce product id. The store launched about Jan 2022 with ids 13860-14700; ids 15500-16010 were added mid/late 2022 (image upload epochs ~Aug 2022); ids >= 18000 (Radius TCI Tricones, slug URLs, images Apr 2025) are clearly newer than a 2022 print catalog.
